mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically for four consecutive weeks (-22.7 to -18.6), indicating entrenched recovery momentum in shopping and leisure activity that should continue to push RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks absent a shock.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC increased every week from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28 days despite the prior four-week monotonic uptrend.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility is already deeply suppressed and oscillating near -30; if it drops further below -32, reduced access to transit hubs co-located with shopping districts will constrain retail footfall within two weeks, lowering RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -32 percent change from baseline in any weekly mean
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has ranged between -29.3 and -31.4 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or stays flat over the two weeks following any week where TRANSIT fell below -32.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT jointly proxy commuting-linked out-of-home behavior; when both decline together in the same week (as at t-1w with WORKPLACES at -24.4 and TRANSIT at -31.4), combined reduction in weekday mobility chains suppresses adjacent retail trips, lowering RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both decline week-on-week simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES dropped to -24.4 at t-1w while TRANSIT also fell to -31.4
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the two weeks following a joint decline in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT in more than half of observed instances.

mechanism_narrative: The decision point of mid-November precedes the pre-Christmas holiday shopping ramp-up in Greater London; seasonal retail demand independent of pandemic-era mobility trends should drive RETAIL_REC upward over the next four weeks regardless of other series.
evidence_refs: fact:decision date 2021-11-15 precedes the pre-holiday shopping period
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days despite the approach of the holiday shopping period.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has remained persistently elevated near +17 to +19 across four weeks, indicating sustained home-centric behavioral caution; if RESIDENTIAL stays above 18 for another week, this caution will suppress near-term retail outings within one week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above 18 percent change from baseline for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL registered 18.6, 17.4, 19.6, 17.4 over the last four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises within one week following a two-week stretch of RESIDENTIAL above 18.

mechanism_narrative: In the absence of any new restriction signals in this snapshot, the current steady-state policy regime (no sharp WORKPLACES or TRANSIT collapse) implies continued gradual reopening, so RETAIL_REC should edge upward week-to-week over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES recovered from -24.4 at t-1w to -15.7 at t-0w with no visible restriction tightening
regime_hint: steady-state reopening with no new restrictions
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines week-over-week despite no observed tightening signal in WORKPLACES or TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: As colder November weather reduces outdoor PARKS activity (already oscillating near -11), displaced leisure time substitutes into indoor retail and recreation venues, pushing RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS has stayed negative between -7.6 and -11.9 over the last four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days while PARKS remains depressed or declines further.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and RESIDENTIAL move as complementary indicators of out-of-home versus home-bound behavior; when TRANSIT rises while RESIDENTIAL simultaneously falls, this joint shift signals increased out-of-home circulation that drives RETAIL_REC higher within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises and RESIDENTIAL falls in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -31.4 to -29.3 while RESIDENTIAL fell from 19.6 to 17.4 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the two weeks following a week where TRANSIT increased and RESIDENTIAL decreased concurrently.
